name: Citizenship by Descent (Child of Armenian Citizens)

qualifying_event.description: A child whose parents are citizens of the Republic of Armenia at the moment of the child's birth acquires Armenian citizenship automatically, regardless of the child's place of birth.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; parents' proof of Armenian citizenship at the time of birth.

requirements.blocker_text: Both parents are citizens of the Republic of Armenia at the moment of the child's birth -- citizenship is acquired automatically regardless of where the child is born.

evidence_required.document: Parents' proof of Armenian citizenship at time of birth

sources.title: ARLIS -- Law on the Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia: automatic citizenship for a child whose parents are Armenian citizens at birth, regardless of birthplace

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Armenia). Only the two-citizen-parents case was confirmed with precise wording in this pass -- the one-parent-citizen case (a common provision in most countries' descent laws) was not independently confirmed against the primary text with the same precision and is not modeled as a separate requirement group here to avoid guessing at unconfirmed conditions; a future pass should verify Article 11's exact single-parent wording directly. This file is narrower and more strictly descent-based than am_citizenship_armenian_origin.json, which extends far beyond children of current citizens to anyone of documented Armenian heritage generally.
